newsitem.title: CHINA: China earns $2.56 bln from foreign tourism in Q1.
newsitem.headline: China earns $2.56 bln from foreign tourism in Q1.

text.p: China earned $2.56 billion from foreign tourism in the first quarter of 1997, a rise of 16.2 percent compared with the year-ago period, the Financial News said on Wednesday.

Some 13 million foreign tourists visited China in the first quarter, up 10.2 percent compared with the year-ago period, the newspaper quoted figures from the National Tourism Administration as saying.

Visitors from Taiwan made 495,500 trips during the period, jumping a year-on-year 34.7 percent while those from Hong Kong and Macau made 10.87 million trips, a rise of 8.75 percent, it said but gave no further details.
